description_en: You can call BatchSetCdnDomainConfig to configure multiple domain names at once
description_zh: 调用BatchSetCdnDomainConfig进行域名批量配置
name: BatchSetCdnDomainConfig

parameters.help_en:
Accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following limits:

You can specify up to 20 domain names in one request.

The total number of domain names multiplied by the number of functions must be 50 or fewer
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，注意以下配置限制：

一次最多传20个域名。
域名个数乘以 Functions个数，小于等于50
parameters.name: domain_names
functions
